title: Bar Drop Apple Cranberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Apple Cranberry by Drop is a crisply refreshing fruit blend that balances orchard-fresh sweetness with a sharp, tangy edge. On the inhale, you’ll experience the bright, juicy taste of ripe green apples, providing a clean and fruity base. This is immediately followed by the tart, slightly floral notes of cranberry, which cut through the sweetness to create a complex, mouth-watering finish. Formulated with a unique 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid is designed to deliver a more profound flavour experience than standard 50/50 blends. The higher PG content carries flavour notes with exceptional clarity while ensuring a discreet vapour production. Combined with a nicotine salt formula available in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths, it offers a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. This blend is optimised for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits and starter devices. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
